name: mashira-pun-contest
reviewNotes: All 24 original glyph records reviewed. Preserve garbled/repeated speech, Mashira and existing 藍猴群, before/after-song branches, controls 08/05 and shop item/price fields.

Historical-name puns are editorial adaptations retaining Napoleon, Camus, Darwin, Seton, Lenin, Fabre, MacArthur, Kublai Khan and Bach references. They require a dedicated language review before release, not literal-equivalence claims.
No contest scoring, reward, purchase or music behavior is changed.
